# duploai_git_repository (Data Source)

Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes Git repository (Flux GitRepository).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a Git repository by ID.
data "duploai_git_repository" "example" {
  workspace_id = "<workspace-id>"
  id           = "<object-id>"
}

output "status" {
  value = data.duploai_git_repository.example.status
}

output "url" {
  value = data.duploai_git_repository.example.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the object to look up.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace that owns this Git repository.

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Map of String) Kubernetes annotations applied to the GitRepository object. The platform's own duplocloud.ai/* annotations are managed server-side and not tracked here.
- `api_version` (String) Flux GitRepository CRD apiVersion. Read-only: the platform always stamps source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1, and any value sent is discarded.
- `description` (String) Free-text description of this Git repository, shown in the DuploCloud console.
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment that owns the resource group.
- `git_provider` (String) Authenticate through the cloud provider rather than a stored secret: azure or github use workload identity, so no secret_ref_name is needed. Leave unset (or use generic) to authenticate with the credentials in secret_ref_name.
- `git_repository_id` (String) Unique identifier of the Git repository record.
- `ignore` (String) Newline-separated .gitignore-style patterns to exclude from the produced artifact, overriding Flux's default exclusions.
- `include` (Attributes List) Overlay content from other Git repositories into this one's artifact, so a single source can assemble files from several repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--include))
- `interval` (String) How often Flux polls the repository for new commits, as a Go duration (30s, 1m, 5m, 1h). This is the sync cadence - not a limit on how long a single fetch may take, which is timeout.
- `labels` (Map of String) Kubernetes labels applied to the GitRepository object. The platform's own duplocloud.ai/* labels are managed server-side and not tracked here.
- `name` (String) Name of the Git repository resource. Must be unique within the namespace.
- `namespace_name` (String) Kubernetes namespace the Git repository is created in. The namespace must already exist under the same resource group.
- `provisioner_type` (String) Provisioning engine used to create the resource.
- `provisioner_version` (String) Version of the provisioning engine.
- `proxy_secret_ref_name` (String) Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding HTTP proxy settings (address, username, password) to use when reaching the repository. Unrelated to repository credentials - those live in secret_ref_name.
- `recurse_submodules` (Boolean) Also clone the repository's Git submodules. Submodules are fetched with the same credentials as the parent repository.
- `ref_branch` (String) Branch to track, e.g. main. Flux re-checks it every interval and picks up new commits. When no ref_* attribute is set at all, Flux falls back to the master branch. Only one ref_* attribute may be set.
- `ref_commit` (String) Exact commit SHA to check out. The strictest option: the source never moves until you change this value. Only one ref_* attribute may be set.
- `ref_name` (String) Full Git refspec, for references the other ref_* attributes cannot name - most often a pull request, e.g. refs/pull/123/head. Also accepts refs/heads/main or refs/tags/v1.0.0. Flux gives this precedence over ref_branch, ref_tag and ref_semver. Only one ref_* attribute may be set.
- `ref_semver` (String) Semver range matched against the repository's tags; Flux checks out the highest tag that satisfies it, e.g. ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0" or "~1.2.0". Use this to follow releases automatically. Only one ref_* attribute may be set.
- `ref_tag` (String) Tag to check out, as a bare tag name such as v1.0.0 (not refs/tags/v1.0.0 - use ref_name for a full refspec). Pins the source until you change the tag. Only one ref_* attribute may be set.
- `resource_group_id` (String) ID of the resource group (Kubernetes cluster) this Git repository belongs to. The cluster must have FluxCD enabled.
- `scope_ids` (List of String) Scope IDs linking this Git repository to a cloud provider account. Derived from the parent resource group; values sent by the caller are rejected.
- `secret_ref_name` (String) Name of an existing Kubernetes Secret in namespace_name that holds the credentials for a private repository. One secret covers every method - HTTPS uses username and password (a personal access token), SSH uses identity and known_hosts, and a self-signed HTTPS endpoint uses caFile. Leave unset for a public repository, or when git_provider handles authentication instead.
- `sparse_checkout` (List of String) Check out only these directories instead of the whole repository, each a path relative to the repository root (e.g. clusters/production). Useful for large monorepos.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status of the Git repository.
- `suspend` (Boolean) Pause reconciliation. Flux stops polling the repository, and the artifact it has already produced stays in place. Set back to false to resume.
- `timeout` (String) How long a single clone or fetch may run before it is abandoned, as a Go duration. Keep it comfortably below interval so a slow fetch cannot overlap the next sync. The cluster defaults it to 60s when unset.
- `url` (String) Repository address to clone. Use an https:// URL with a username/password secret, or an ssh:// URL with an SSH key secret - see secret_ref_name. Example: https://github.com/org/repo.git or ssh://git@github.com/org/repo.git.
- `verify_mode` (String) Verify Git signatures against the public keys in verify_secret_ref_name, and refuse to build an artifact if the signature does not check out. Flux accepts head (the checked-out commit), Tag, and TagAndHead. Passed to the cluster unchanged and validated there. Leave unset to skip verification.
- `verify_secret_ref_name` (String) Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the PGP public keys used to check commit or tag signatures. Required whenever verify_mode is set. Not a credential for cloning - that is secret_ref_name.

<a id="nestedatt--include"></a>
### Nested Schema for `include`

Read-Only:

- `from_path` (String) Path inside the included repository to copy from. Defaults to its root.
- `repository_name` (String) Name of another Git repository resource in the same namespace whose content should be overlaid.
- `to_path` (String) Path inside this repository's artifact to copy into. Defaults to the included repository's name.
